value.rationale: The dependence of isolated component count on retained edge count is a natural percolation statistic. Its sharp extremizer is not merely the path or star: optimizers have predominantly degree-five hubs with an exact four-class residue correction and two tied hub profiles at infinitely many orders. The all-order exchange argument gives a motivated complete classification of an interpretable host-topology boundary, rather than an arbitrary finite enumeration.
